I quickly hacked together a simple python script to find string occurrences in all project source files.
The script found 2 editor settings that were not referenced anywhere (except for `editor_settings.cpp` and `EditorSettings.xml`):
 
- `editors/grid_map/palette_min_width`
- `interface/editor/code_font_custom_variations`

The EditorSetting `interface/editor/code_font_custom_variations` was last changed in 2020 in commit c1d261fd by @bruvzg. 
Can you confirm that this setting is no longer used? 

It might be useful to include this script in the CI pipeline to catch unused editor settings. I’ll refactor the script and share the updated version here later.

Hi, I want to disable the auto tab switch on debugging to stack_trace, and the property `debugger/auto_switch_to_stack_trace` is not working as described.
A debugger run is always switching to the stack_trace tab, but i want to avoid this in my scenario.
Is there a fix or workaround?

```
	var settings := EditorInterface.get_editor_settings()
	settings.set_setting("debugger/auto_switch_to_stack_trace", false)
```

- `editors/grid_map/palette_min_width` no longer exists on latest
- `interface/editor/code_font_custom_variations` is used as per [the PR linked above](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/109609#issuecomment-3913683178)

so I think this can be closed?

---
